# History Record 220: Master Integration Plan (Iteration 3) Phase 7 & 8: Dynamic VRAM Lifecycle Manager & Master Integration E2E QA

**Date**: 2026-10-16  
**Status**: Completed  
**Scope**: `apps/ai-supervisor`, `apps/ai-supervisor/python-backend`, `packages/proto`, `packages/core`, `apps/worker`, `apps/studio`, `autogenerated-tests/`  

---

## 1. Context & Objectives
Iteration 3 focused on the desktop control plane and multi-daemon orchestration architecture:
- **Phase 7 (Dynamic VRAM Memory Manager & Admin gRPC Service)**: Implement an enterprise-grade model lifecycle manager in the Python AI subsystem with LRU tracking, 120s idle auto-eviction, synchronized PyTorch CUDA cache clearing, generational garbage collection, and Protobuf contract `/acc.v1.AdminService/PurgeVRAM` and `/acc.v1.AdminService/GetVRAMStatus`.
- **Phase 8 (Master Integration & End-to-End QA)**: Validate the complete multi-daemon orchestration lifecycle across the Electrobun Supervisor, Standalone Task Worker, Pure Client React 19 Studio, and resilient Python AI daemon. Ensure zero zombie processes, clean signal propagation, and verified acceptance criteria.

---

## 2. Key Technical Implementations

### 2.1 ModelLifecycleManager (`apps/ai-supervisor/python-backend/src/services/model_lifecycle_manager.py`)
- Thread-safe singleton (`ModelLifecycleManager.get_instance(idle_timeout_sec=120.0)`).
- Model registration with estimated VRAM footprints (e.g. `depth_anything_v2` ~350MB, `sam_segmenter` ~450MB, `kokoro_tts` ~180MB).
- Model touch tracking resetting idle timestamps on every inference invocation.
- Background eviction thread checking idle timeouts every 5 seconds.
- `purge_all(force=True)` triggering custom model unload callbacks, generational Python `gc.collect()`, and `torch.cuda.empty_cache()` + `torch.cuda.ipc_collect()`.
- Real-time `get_vram_status()` inspecting active models and GPU VRAM via `torch.cuda.mem_get_info()`.

### 2.2 Protobuf Admin Contract & Compilation (`packages/proto`)
- Defined `packages/proto/proto/acc/v1/admin.proto`:
  - `AdminService` with `PurgeVRAM(PurgeVRAMRequest) -> PurgeVRAMResponse`
  - `GetVRAMStatus(VRAMStatusRequest) -> VRAMStatusResponse`
- Compiled Python stubs via uv into `apps/ai-supervisor/python-backend/src/generated/admin_pb2.py` and `admin_pb2_grpc.py`.
- Exported TypeScript client helper `getAdminServiceClient` from `@acc/proto`.

### 2.3 IPC Facade & Supervisor Engine Integration (`@acc/core` & `apps/ai-supervisor`)
- Integrated `purgeVRAM(force)` and `getVRAMStatus()` into `GRPCAIStrategy` and the root `IPCFacade` class with automatic fallback.
- Wired `apps/ai-supervisor/src/bun/SupervisorEngine.ts` `purgeAllVram()` to dispatch Ollama model unloads and call the Python backend gRPC `AdminService/PurgeVRAM`.

### 2.4 Master Integration & Build Artifacts
- Added root development & build orchestration scripts to `package.json`:
  - `supervisor:dev`, `supervisor:build`
  - `worker:dev`
  - `studio:dev`, `studio:build`
- Built production client distribution for React Studio (`apps/studio/dist/client`) in 3.06s.
